diff --git a/src/auth/middleware.py b/src/auth/middleware.py
index 1234567..zzzzzzz 100644
--- a/src/auth/middleware.py
+++ b/src/auth/middleware.py
@@ -10,6 +10,12 @@ class AuthMiddleware:
     def __init__(self, app):
         self.app = app
+        self.rate_limiter = RateLimiter()
+
+    def check_rate_limit(self, request) -> bool:
+        client_ip = request.client.host
+        return self.rate_limiter.allow(client_ip)
+
     def __call__(self, request):
+        if not self.check_rate_limit(request):
+            return Response(status_code=429)
         return self.app(request)
